about: S10 gate (design §12): do two-hop questions need a memory graph? Each user's memories are stored as said (no model); a question needs two of them — one naming a person, place or thing, one saying something about it without repeating how the user relates to it. `hops` are keywords of the two memories the answer needs; distractors say similar things about other people. Fictional people only.
